threat_event: Ransomware or an infostealer on the laptop encrypts files, steals guarantor documents, and harvests browser-saved passwords that open the access control and thermostat portals
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Portal passwords saved in the browser and reused; no MFA on building portals; no backup of files or laptop; no security training
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-07 laptop; SYS-06 files; SYS-01 and SYS-03 through stolen passwords (BP-01, BP-02, BP-05)
existing_controls: Disk encryption; automatic updates; built-in antivirus
treatment_plan: MFA on every building portal; password manager and clear the browser store; email and file backup; owner training; P08 runbook

threat_event: Attacker signs in to the access control, video, or thermostat portal with a guessed, phished, or reused password and unlocks entrances, adds credentials, deletes video, or changes HVAC schedules
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No MFA on any building portal although all three offer it; reused passwords; nobody reviews admin changes
existing_controls: Password only; vendor logs admin changes
treatment_plan: Turn on MFA for every administrator account (owner and installer) by app; unique passphrases; monthly review of admin changes

threat_event: The installer's standing administrator accounts are misused or taken over (installer staff turnover, or a breach at the installer) and used to control doors and cameras
threat_source: Trusted contractor or attacker using its account (supply chain)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Installer keeps permanent full administrator accounts in SYS-01 and SYS-02; no MFA; no written security terms or incident notice; accounts never reviewed
treatment_plan: Remove standing accounts; grant a time-limited account per service visit with MFA; one-page security terms with 72-hour incident notice

threat_event: Guarantor files (Social Security numbers, driver license copies, credit reports) are exposed through the 'anyone with the link' folder link or an email account takeover
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Folder shared by a public link since 2024; files kept in email attachments; no retention rule; email MFA by text message only
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-06 email and files (BP-05); about 15 guarantors
existing_controls: Email MFA by text message; data compromise endorsement on the business owner's policy
treatment_plan: Remove the public link (done 2026-08-05, when the CPA's named share was set up); move guarantor files out of email into one restricted folder; delete files past retention; app-based MFA on email

threat_event: A customer device on the free lobby Wi-Fi, or an attacker in range, reaches cameras, door controllers, thermostats, or the router's admin page on the flat network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One flat network; guest isolation off; router admin password is the factory default; router firmware from 2023
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-04 router; SYS-01 to SYS-03 devices (BP-01, BP-02)
existing_controls: Devices talk to their clouds over TLS; no inbound port forwards
treatment_plan: Change the router password now; business router with a building-device network and an isolated guest network; firmware updates

threat_event: A former tenant employee, janitorial worker, or contractor uses a credential that was never removed to enter after hours (theft, vandalism, or harm to tenants)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Credentials removed only when someone remembers; tenants never confirm lists; no review (7 of 58 credentials belonged to people who had left)
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 credentials; building and tenant premises (BP-01)
existing_controls: Entrances locked after hours; cameras at the entrances
treatment_plan: Tenants and contractors must report departures within 1 business day (lease rules letter); monthly credential review; disable credentials unused for 60 days

threat_event: Thermostat schedules or setpoints are changed by mistake or misuse through the login shared with the HVAC contractor, and suites overheat or units run all night
threat_source: HVAC contractor staff or attacker using the shared login
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One owner login shared with the contractor; no MFA; the platform cannot show who changed what
existing_controls: Thermostats can be set at the wall
treatment_plan: Separate contractor user with limited rights; change the owner password; MFA

threat_event: Internet or vendor cloud outage stops remote control of doors, cameras, or thermostats for most of a day
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single internet line; all building control is cloud-managed
existing_controls: Controllers cache credentials and schedules; thermostats keep last schedule; mechanical keys; vendor availability commitments (P09)
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Keep mechanical keys and wall controls working; write the manual procedures (R-009 plan)

threat_event: The owner is suddenly unavailable (illness, injury, travel) or loses the only phone, so nobody can lock the building, restore cooling, or reach the vendors
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One person holds every role, key, and credential; every second factor on one phone; no written manual procedures
existing_controls: Mechanical keys exist; contractors know the building
treatment_plan: Manual procedures; sealed envelope with recovery codes and spare keys at the attorney's office; written fallback arrangements with the HVAC contractor and installer; tenant emergency contact sheet (P05)

threat_event: Face recognition ('familiar faces') and entrance audio recorded people without notice or assessment, creating FTC Section 5 and Fla. Stat. 934.03 exposure and tenant distrust
threat_source: Vendor default settings and owner trial
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Optional AI and audio features turned on with no assessment, notice, or approval rule
existing_controls: Audio and face recognition turned off 2026-07-21
treatment_plan: Retire face recognition; delete face data and confirm with the vendor; keep audio off; P10 approval before any new AI or audio feature; notice signs

threat_event: Email, files, or the access control configuration are lost (account lockout, accidental deletion, ransomware, or a tampered configuration) with no copy to restore from
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No backup of email, files, or laptop; no export of door schedules, access groups, or credential list
existing_controls: Provider deleted-items retention; vendor platform backups
treatment_plan: Third-party backup of mail and files with version history; monthly access control export; laptop backup to an encrypted drive

threat_event: An incident is not recognized in time, or the Florida 30-day notice deadline is missed, because there is no plan or contact list
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident plan, contact list, or training before 2026-08-31
existing_controls: Insurer breach hotline on the data compromise endorsement
treatment_plan: Adopt and print the P08 runbook and notification matrix; walk through it with the IT consultant; owner training

threat_event: An attacker in the owner's email sends tenants fake bank-change instructions for rent, or redirects a contractor payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Email MFA by text message; no call-back rule for payment changes; insurance excludes funds-transfer fraud
existing_controls: Rent is paid through the tenant portal, not by bank details sent in email
treatment_plan: Notice to tenants that bank details never change by email; call-back rule for any payment change; app-based MFA; email authentication records (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) on the domain

threat_event: Guarantor credit reports and license copies are thrown out or a device is disposed of without being made unreadable
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No retention or disposal rule; paper printouts and downloads kept indefinitely
existing_controls: Paper lease files in a locked cabinet
treatment_plan: Retention rule (POL-01 8.6); cross-cut shredder; delete downloads; wipe old devices; disposal record

threat_event: A hurricane or long power outage takes the building's internet and devices offline for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One building; router and controllers on building power; no battery backup for the router
existing_controls: Doors fail secure with free egress; mechanical keys; SaaS reachable from anywhere by phone
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Small battery backup for the router and controllers at the next router replacement; before a storm, export the access control configuration
